definition: [ חָתָה ] verb snatch up , usually fire, coals (Late Hebrew id. ; ᵑ7 חֲתָא , id. (rare); Assyrian —atû is destroy (i.e. snatch away ? ) see SASm Asrb i. 90 ) — Qal Imperfect יַחְתֶּה Prov 6:27 suffix יַחְתְּךָ Ps 52:7 Infinitive construct לַחְתּוֺת Isa 30:14 Participle חֹתֶה Prov 25:22 — snatch up , with accusative אֵשׁ מִיָּקוּד Isa 30:14 to snatch up fire from a hearth (|| לַחְשׂף מים מִגֶּבֶא ); אֵשׁ בְּחֵיקוֺ Prov 6:27 shall a man snatch up fire in his bosom and his garments not be burned ? (in simile of adulterer); pregnantly seize (and put) upon עלרֿאֹשׁוֺ ׳ גְּחָלִים אַתָּה ח Prov 25:22 יַחְתְּךָ וְיִסָּֽחֲךָ מֵאֹ֑הֶל Ps 52:7 God . . . shall snatch thee away , and pluck thee up tent-less.
